description: This module handles dependency injection for the Superset core API, replacing abstract classes and functions with concrete implementations for DAOs, models, queries, tasks, REST API endpoints, and session management.

methods.name: inject_dao_implementations
methods.description: Replaces abstract DAO classes in the core API with concrete implementations from Superset.

methods.name: inject_model_implementations
methods.description: Replaces abstract model classes in the core API with concrete implementations from Superset.

methods.name: inject_query_implementations
methods.description: Replaces abstract query functions with concrete implementations, including dialect retrieval.

methods.name: inject_task_implementations
methods.description: Replaces abstract task functions and classes with concrete implementations.

methods.name: inject_rest_api_implementations
methods.description: Replaces REST API registration functions with concrete implementations using appbuilder.

methods.name: inject_model_session_implementation
methods.description: Replaces get_session function to return the current database session.

methods.name: initialize_core_api_dependencies
methods.description: Initializes all dependency injections for the core API.
